note: Short summaries of each weapon's own (last) skill effect, for ItJustLogs' loadouts. Written from wiki/weapons.json's skill text (endfield.wiki.gg, CC BY-SA 4.0). {k} is that skill's values[k] at its level; markup as in wiki/weapons.json. The leading stat the skill always gives ({0} in most) is shown apart and left out here. `branches`: only the one whose `if` holds for the wielder's attributes applies. Checked by scripts/check-weapon-summaries.mjs.
